svg.aria-label: Left: mean length of the last 10 CartPole episodes after each batch of 2,048 steps, three seeds each, for PPO with clip 0.2 and 10 epochs, the unclipped surrogate with 10 epochs, and the unclipped surrogate with one epoch; PPO reaches 500 within 15 batches on every seed, the unclipped 10-epoch version is fast but unstable, and the one-epoch version is slow. Right: the KL divergence moved by each update on a log scale; the unclipped 10-epoch updates are about a hundred times larger than PPO's, the one-epoch updates several times smaller
